title: Field signal priming: consolidated enterprise request queue + initial tech/econ triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable process and artifacts for aggregating enterprise feature asks from Sales/CS and producing a consistent initial triage: engineering impact, compliance/security flags, rough effort bands, and a ballpark cost/ROI note. This ticket delivers the intake template, scoring rubric, sample aggregated bundle output, and handoff checklist for PMs to hand to Eng/Product-design for deeper scoping.
background: We get high-volume enterprise asks that vary widely in fidelity. Current intake is fragmented across Slack, Drive, and ad-hoc spreadsheets. That slows first-response, causes duplicate evaluation work, and makes it hard to prioritize requests that materially affect Dedicated/Private product lines (capacity, data residency, audit logs). Sales needs a faster 'yes/no/more-info' within 7 business days and a transparent rationale when we deprioritize.
proposal_summary: 1) Build a canonical Sales/CS intake bundle (CSV + short narrative) that consolidates related asks by account and feature theme. 2) Attach a 3-axis initial triage: Technical Risk (low/med/high), Implementation Size (S/M/L/XL), and Business Urgency (low/med/high). 3) Produce an automated one-page snapshot for PM review: recommended next step (Quick spec / Spike / Full PRD), expected owners, estimated resources, and suggested time-to-first-delivery window. 4) Create an internal template + playbook and train frontline CS reps on minimal capture fields.
acceptance_criteria: Intake template (CSV + short narrative) is finalized and stored in Confluence
Scoring rubric documented with example scored bundles for 6 past enterprise asks
One-page snapshot output generated for at least 5 real historical asks and validated with Sales reps
Handoff checklist created and reviewed by Eng and Security with explicit gating criteria
First training session delivered to CS (recording + slides in Drive)
PM signoff on triage thresholds and recommended next-step mapping
tasks: Query historical tickets and cluster similar asks (owner: PM + Data Analyst)
Define scoring bands for Technical Risk, Size, Urgency (owner: Eng lead + PM)
Create snapshot generator script (owner: Eng - prototype)

Run 5 retrospective bundles through new playbook and collect Sales feedback
Publish Confluence playbook and schedule CS training

decisions: Adopt 3-axis triage (Technical Risk, Implementation Size, Business Urgency) rather than a single score to preserve nuance.
Make three fields mandatory for Sales: short problem statement, customer pain / revenue signal, and expected timeframe. Other fields optional.
Automated snapshot will include a conservative 'effort band' (S/M/L/XL) with mapping to nominal story points for planning.
If Security gating is triggered, the bundle automatically routes to Security and marks as 'Blocked' until clearance.
implementation_risks: Sales adoption: if the template is too heavy, CS will revert to notes in CRM and we lose structured data.
False negatives on security flags if Sales omits details; need periodic audit of flagged vs unflagged historical asks.
Edge cases: cross-account feature asks that span product lines may be difficult to cluster automatically.
Prototype snapshot accuracy depends on engineering heuristics; initial estimates will be conservative and must be surfaced as such.
notes_on_estimation: Effort bands map to story points as follows: S=3-8, M=8-20, L=20-60, XL=60+. These are intentionally wide. For Dedicated/Private infra changes (capacity, regionalization), add an extra risk buffer and escalate to a spike before committing to timeline.
